faqs.question: What is covered in Machine Design subject in B.Tech course?
faqs.answer:
Dear candidate, the subject of Machine Design basically teaches you about the designing fundamentals of various types of machinery across industries. You get to learn about the different ways in which elements can be combined to form an equipment or machine system and get the work done in an effective manner.
The knowledge of this subject is very important for a mechanical engineer as he/she will have to put this to use in the future whenever they enter the workforce as a mechanical engineering professional.
Hope this cleared your doubt. Have a good day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: College is very old-fashioned and the worst.

review_content.Placements: 80% of students got placed from my course, and it is divided into separate classes by average and bright students. They give more importance to bright students. Students gets placed in companies like Cognizant and Movate, only some amount of students gets internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel students describe their hostel life as bad. They find insects in their hostel food. Hostel food is very bad in price. Most students won't even eat. You can go and come whenever you want from hostel. Hostel facility is very poor. It is very bad.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Outstanding learning experience with practical insights.

review_content.Placements: 80% of the students were placed from the course. The highest package - is 4.5 LPA, the lowest package - is 2.5 LPA, average package - is 3 LPA. TCS, Infosys, Sutherland, Tata-related companies, more, etc. Software engineer, testing, vice process data analyst. Most students got internships and they were also placed in the same companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the courses varied from different departments. The facilities are very good and clean, library looks silent and peaceful. The hostel was clean and neat, the food was medium, and the medical facilities and sports were a very high priority.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: My college life - The teachers are well trained.

review_content.Placements: Many companies visited my college, including MNCs, Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, and Accenture. The teachers give training to students three months prior to get better placements. The highest package is 2 lakhs per year. 95% of students were placed in the top companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: For my subject, there are 3 staff members. For each subject, one staff member will teach, and another two will inspect us. Lab fees are around 6500, and the breakage fee is around 500. The hostel fee is 90,000, and the quality of food is also very hygienic. They provide the food on time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Quite disappointed by the college curriculum and placements, wish they develop it soon.

review_content.Placements: The placements in the college are very average. I'm from the 2020-2024 batch and we hardly had 4 companies on campus and around 8 off-campus placements. Most of the companies that came for placement offered around 2.5 to 3 LPA, and the top company that came for placement was Accenture. Around 25 female candidates were placed.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are pretty decent but not enough equipment. Hostels are available for boys and girls separately, but the food is mediocre. There's a big ground in college, but it's used only once or twice a year for sports events; the rest of the time, it's used as a parking lot for college buses.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: If you want a degree with a reasonable price and more knowledge with less college enjoyment.

review_content.Placements: In my course, only a few students got placed in companies like HCL, TCS, and some more companies. The highest and the lowest packages offered by the course are 15 to 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies are HCL, TCS, Azure, etc. The percentage of students who got internships from these companies is high, and the roles offered to them are from freshers to HR.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and design of the college campus buildings are good. There are two blocks: one is the main block and the other is the PG block. There are also separate blocks for the mechanical and civil departments. The classrooms have their own Wi-Fi connections for students. The quality of the food in the canteen is not good, and there are no medical facilities inside the college. There is a sports complex block for using sports equipment, and there is also a gym inside the complex.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Disappointed with the strict rules that they have and also with the placement offers.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students placed last year was very low, like 5%. As my college has been autonomous since last year, the placement offerings have drastically reduced, and only a very few companies have approached us. I'm in my last year of college; till now, we have only one college for placement offers, and we hope some will come in the future.
review_content.Infrastructure: I really feel sad about infrastructure, especially in labs, as we have 5–6 labs in the computer field, but none of the labs are air conditioned. This really causes the computer to not work properly. The infrastructure of the college could be better. The canteen food provided will not be good to that level but still, the cost of food is high.

Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate.
Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply.
Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced.
Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five year

hostel_campus.college_name: Prince Shri Venkateshwara Padmavathy Engineering College Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: College is very old-fashioned and the worst.
reviews.review_text: Hostel students describe their hostel life as bad. They find insects in their hostel food. Hostel food is very bad in price. Most students won't even eat. You can go and come whenever you want from hostel. Hostel facility is very poor. It is very bad.

reviews.review_heading: Outstanding learning experience with practical insights.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the courses varied from different departments. The facilities are very good and clean, library looks silent and peaceful. The hostel was clean and neat, the food was medium, and the medical facilities and sports were a very high priority.

reviews.review_heading: My college life - The teachers are well trained.
reviews.review_text: For my subject, there are 3 staff members. For each subject, one staff member will teach, and another two will inspect us. Lab fees are around 6500, and the breakage fee is around 500. The hostel fee is 90,000, and the quality of food is also very hygienic. They provide the food on time.

reviews.review_heading: Quite disappointed by the college curriculum and placements, wish they develop it soon.
reviews.review_text: Labs are pretty decent but not enough equipment. Hostels are available for boys and girls separately, but the food is mediocre. There's a big ground in college, but it's used only once or twice a year for sports events; the rest of the time, it's used as a parking lot for college buses.

reviews.review_heading: If you want a degree with a reasonable price and more knowledge with less college enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and design of the college campus buildings are good. There are two blocks: one is the main block and the other is the PG block. There are also separate blocks for the mechanical and civil departments. The classrooms have their own Wi-Fi connections for students. The quality of the food in the canteen is not good, and there are no medical facilities inside the college. There is a sports complex block for using sports equipment, and there is also a gym inside the complex.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed with the strict rules that they have and also with the placement offers.
reviews.review_text: I really feel sad about infrastructure, especially in labs, as we have 5–6 labs in the computer field, but none of the labs are air conditioned. This really causes the computer to not work properly. The infrastructure of the college could be better. The canteen food provided will not be good to that level but still, the cost of food is high.

reviews.review_heading: Average infrastructure, good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Three-block building; classroom has no Wi-Fi; ARVR lab and five normal labs; smart classroom in one block; projector in the classroom; library available Hostel food is average, canteen food is normal, but the canteen is not that much bigger. In terms of importance to sports, vendors have machines for snakes available.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. In the hostel, there are no rules. It is a free zone, like a home. All the facilities are available. Wi-Fi, labs, and a library are available at our college. A gym is also available. Sports are conducted. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: The placements and campus are good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are not bad, but it needs to be improved. Labs are well-equipped and well maintained. Classrooms are huge enough and spacious. The library is good. The canteen quality must be upgraded. There are only occasional sports events, and nothing much regarding sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college offered good placements and a better place to do B. Tech course.
reviews.review_text: There was no Wi-Fi in our college if you're expecting that and mobile phones are not allowed too. The lab sessions were good I would say. There is a library session every week. The hostel infrastructure was good and I came to know the food was not so great. No medical facilities were available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college was good until 2016.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but not for students. Laboratories are good. Hostels are not good. Weekly once, students are allowed to go out. Students can't even take sick leave without any procedure. Mobiles are not allowed on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students who want to study the course for basic knowledge and to get more.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good enough to learn. Many things are good here except for the hostel facilities and sports. Our college built a sports area, but they are not at all interested in students for to take sports and to play. Medical facilities are not available. The food served is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college to study. The atmosphere is also good here.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility in the college. Classrooms have fans, metal desks for writing and sitting and good air circulation. In the library, the atmosphere is good, and it has a variety of books. The food served in a mess and canteen is average. Sports and games are average in college. Facilities for other activities are average, but studies are good here.

reviews.review_heading: Our college gives priority to education than socialize and cultural things of students.
reviews.review_text: I came to know that Wi-Fi routers were installed after our tenure at our college. All the facilities here were well and good enough for students. Mostly, our college doesn't give much importance to sports and even for sports quota students. The quality of the food served here is above average. Medical facilities are not sufficiently available here as our college is located in the remote area.

reviews.review_heading: The place to learn discipline.
reviews.review_text: We have a small campus but all the basic needs for the students are provided inside the college. They also provide best lab training for the students. We also have a big playground for the students. We also have SAE club in our college. The college also has a good library for studying.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: It is best for a bachelor's degree in B.Sc. Agri. Hons. The infrastructure and facilities are good.

review_content.Placements: There are 200 students studying on our main campus located at Palanpur Dantiwada, and including sub-branches, we have around 260 seats. There are very few to moderate placements because there is not any big industry present in the locality. In the year 2020, 10 students were placed through campus recruitment with the highest salary package of 13 LPA. The average package is between 2 LPA and 2.5 LPA. The placements are not very impressive because half of the batch apply for PG study. Some students start their own businesses or become entrepreneurs. Top recruiting companies are Agro Star, IDBI Bank, Kisan Sanchar, IFFCO, and some other NGO's. At our college, only about 2% to 3% of students get the opportunity to do an internship. They offer a role as a junior executive bank manager.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with great teachers, good hostels, sports grounds, and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Around 30-35% of students are placed in this course. The average salary pacakge offered is Rs 30,000. They offered roles as company department managers at fertilizer factories, in research fields, etc. Different private companies are there as well as some government companies also.
review_content.Infrastructure: In this college, there are 3 libraries, separate laboratories for different subjects with all the needed equipment. Wi-Fi facilities are available, air-conditioned classrooms with a capacity of 80 students per class. They a lot 3 students or room with combine washroom between two rooms, food is good and healthy as well as heavy. PHC is there for any type of emergency, and other medical facilities. There are volleyball, basketball, cricket table tennis, badminton, athletics, gym, swimming pool are also available.

review_summary.college_name: Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very Best University BGSBU.

content.Placements: Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University has a separate training and placement cell which chooses the bright students and helps in placements. The university also provides free coaching for SSB and other exams. The companies visit our campus and recruit the students. There must be a minimum of 60% of students to be selected. The major companies are Mahindra, Amazon, etc. The average salary for selected students is Rs.20000 to Rs.30000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University has the best infrastructure. Newly built buildings, classes, laboratories, a sports complex, synthetic athletic grounds, and a tennis court are available on campus. The university has excellent hostel facility, rooms, Wi-Fi facility in the hostel and campus. It is far better than other private institutes. Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University will be like heaven for the students.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the experience, and I got to learn a lot.

content.Placements: High-value companies come for placements every year, and many students get placed. The university has a placement cell, which actively helps students to get in contact with the reputed companies, and they visit for the interview and recruit the best candidates suited.
content.Infrastructure: The college is perfect, and the timing is also perfect. University provides high-speed Wi-Fi for 24x7 on the premises to help students study through the internet. The university provides a suited environment for students to grow.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college has an excellent atmosphere to study.

content.Placements: Placements on this campus are very poor, and 0.1% of the students got placed. Companies which are visiting the campus are very low graded, but the college grooms students for the future and helps students in real life sceneries. The department helps in internships for students and has given students the real corporate structure for an internship.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good, and there are separate labs for each department. Wi-Fi is widely available, and classrooms are excellent and well-equipped. The hostel serves traditional food of the state, and it is maintaining its hygiene and cleanness. There is a well-established hospital on the campus and a good library. The campus is perfectly placed in between the hills, and it is very beautiful to watch.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Best university in Jammu with good facilities.

content.Placements: The students in my batch that were placed was around 40 % and every year around 40 to 50 percent get placed. The highest salary was 6 LPA and the lowest was 3 5 LPA and average was 3 LPA. The recruiting companies visit every year in the University like wipro, tata, Infosys etc. The roles that were offered were as firewall assistant, software analyst and providing technical support. The highest salary package was 7 LPA and the lowest was 3.4 kpa and average was 3lpa in my course. The 30 % of students got internship from my course and in wipro, suntech, Infosys.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Partially satisfied. Though it is beautiful due to the greenery everywhere.

content.Placements: There are placements in our college, but very little. After the new VC have joined, there is a change in the placements. Our college management are planning to get more MNC companies for the placements. The current VC is trying his best to improvise the placement percentage. Which is a good initiative leaving behind the rumours about the placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. The classrooms have chairs with pads. And the climate of the campus is fine to study. The infra in the labs are expensive, and they don't have enough experienced technician's in the labs. Few labs are quite spacious, whereas some are small. The roads are uphill and the hostels are near.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the college is very good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in my course are very good like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms. The library in our college is very good and the books facilities are like research, articles, programming and coding books etc. The quality of food is good in our hostel. In the hostel there are medical facilities, gym, indoor games, and etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and I recommend others to join the college.
reviews.review_text: There is good infrastructure because of the library and other departments. I can't say it is awesome but I like it. The infrastructure of the library is always good. When you come to the ECE department, toilets are good. The gym and hostel are very good.

reviews.review_heading: College is good but they have to develop the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Some facilities are good while some are average. There is no Wi-Fi provided in classes or library or labs. In hostel, Wi-Fi is provided but it does not work properly. Food in the canteen is good but somewhat expensive as compared to outside.

reviews.review_heading: The college should improve placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, classroom, labs, library, workshop, seminar hall, projectors, practical sessions, etc. are there. Hostel facilities are not bad, and fees are acceptable. Medical facilities are good. Sports and games are also encouraged at our college. Sports like volleyball, basketball, cricket, etc. have active participation in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, seminar halls, workshops, libraries, projectors, and computers are available. Food quality is average. Medical facilities were good. And sports and games also provide good participation and encouragement for students. Cricket, basketball, volleyball, and other games are encouraged.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students in this locality, but I would not recommend it for others.
reviews.review_text: The iconic part of the college was the central library. It was huge. You can also see some ancient books and antiques. The campus was good with average greenery. Recently, there was renovation work. Now, it's much better. Hostels were good, but fees were high after renovation. Wi-Fi was provided only for laptops. Labs were fine.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our college as I got everything I expected, including good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was quite enough for students. Every classroom had a projector. Our college had a huge library with all kinds of books, from curriculum-related books to novels. It had a good hostel. The quality of the food was good. It had a huge ground to place every sport and game like cricket, football, basketball, and Kabaddi. We also played indoor games like table tennis and chess.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend students to join this college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were good. The library was good. The mess was not that good. Wi-Fi was also not good. Labs were not that advanced. Lab assistants were fine.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Chandrasekharendra Saraswathi Viswa Mahavidyalaya.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available throughout the campus. Our labs and classroom were good and well-furnished. The library had over 100,000 books. The hostel was good. The quality of food in the mess was good. The canteen was excellent. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were very important in college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the college is average. Because this college is not familiar in kanchipuram also.
reviews.review_text: In my department, we have the best computer lab facility with high speed internet. We have average classrooms, seminar hall, mini department libraries and a big college Library. Hostel facility is good. The quality of food is good only and it is vegetarian. A medical center is available. Playground and gym are available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Sri Jayendra Saraswathi Ayurveda College and HospitalReviewed on 28 Sep 2022)
reviews.review_heading: It is an affordable college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are quite good, but not worth it for the given fees. The infrastructure of SJSCAH is not good because it has only a single building named both the administrative block and the academic block, which also includes small rooms as departments.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Chandrasekharendra Saraswathi Viswa Mahavidyalaya University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good and comfortable. The hostel is better than before. Ayurvedic medicines are provided as treatment. The canteen is good. Sports and games are encouraged. The ground is good for playing. The infrastructure is good and they are making it better. The library is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Very good placement in our university. Very good infrastructure. Faculty is good
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities and infrastructure in our university. The Wi-Fi facility is good. Library facility is good. Labs are very clean and rooms are air conditioned. Medical facilities are available inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Somewhat good about studies and placements in CSE but not good for some branches.
reviews.review_text: Our campus had no Wi-Fi. Classrooms were good and the library was wonderful. There were good labs but the presentation of the equipment was less. When strength is more, it is not enough. Students are divided into two batches. There were hostels at our university. The hostel was good and served better food.

reviews.review_heading: Years becomes days at SCSVMU.
reviews.review_text: Our college had a decent environment and good infrastructure. Course wise, we were upgraded a lot but still, need changes in the style of exams and others. All our classrooms were equipped with smart class systems. It was a very clean and eco-friendly environment. We had good sports facilities.

reviews.review_text: All our facilities and infrastructure were available for my course. The wi-fi, classrooms, library, and labs were all well-equipped. The quality of food in my hostel canteen was good. Medical facilities were available on campus, and sports and games were also provided.

reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my department were super. Wi-Fi classroom library everything is available in the my course. reviews.review_heading: PET Engineering College for MBA Admission provides information about Placement and Facilities in 202
reviews.review_text: This college provides very good infrastructure and high-quality materials and products like fast Wi-Fi connection, computers, a library with all books, labs, hostels, etc. Facilities are available in this college. The college canteen provides very tasty and clean food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PET Engineering College in 2025 admission for MBA course .
reviews.review_text: This college used high-quality infrastructure facilities. This college has many facilities like classrooms, labs, bathrooms, a garden, a gymkhana, a turf, etc. It was a college that was providing the best canteen food, and very tasty food was available.

reviews.review_heading: Management Course at PET.
reviews.review_text: There are no Wi-Fi available on campus. There are many limitations like we are not allowed to wear jeans. They had a good library with the availability of so many books. Hostel facilities are provided by our college. In each room of hostel, there is an accommodation of 2-3 students.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in this college and the teaching quality is excellent.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is extremely beautiful. I can tell that overall the facilities were good. The classrooms are big and the labs are well equipped. The subject books are available in the library. The hostel facilities are good. I have studied in a hostel for 2 years and the overall experience was good. Wi-Fi is available.

reviews.review_heading: Instead of studying in this course, better learn a certificate course related to your field of work.
reviews.review_text: At PET Engineering College, there were many limitations for students. There was no Wi-Fi, mobile devices, or jeans allowed on campus. They had a good library, average hostel food, and excellent food at the canteen. We had six labs with Wi-Fi, printers, and scanners. There was a server room that managed all the machines in the six labs. Our college had a projector facility for presentations, workshops, and seminars.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely a worth for middle class family students.
reviews.review_text: Nice hostel facility especially the canteen and mess facilities for other area people were awesome. The campus is nearby valliyur and almost 5km away from it. The best thing about our college infrastructure is it is fully green based college. Also our college plays a vital role on symposium to improve students ability among future.

reviews.review_heading: Not worthy because of their extra fees, No respect from management.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi but they don't give permissions, Not Perfect classroom but they put Common fine, No medical facilities, Sports and games are happened in annual and sports day. Labs Equipment are useless and they used to taught canteen foods are not so good. Come and see my college you can see the half finished building work.

reviews.review_heading: Iam really satisfied with our college which is good in education. I recommend others to join our clg
reviews.review_text: In our college the labs are good and the infrastructure used for mechanical and civil engineering infrastructure is very good. The classrooms are in Digital condition. The library also have 5000 volumes of new edition. In our college sports are also conducted annually. Medical camps are also available when service is need.

reviews.review_heading: Somewhat better and good infrastructure and better teaching and a neat and calm environment.
reviews.review_text: Very good infrastructure. There are seperate laboratories for each and every subject in every department. Especially Mechanical dept ECE, CSE dept labs are very well-equipped. All the labs have the latest and good working machines in it. There are very well trained lab assistants too. They help students in their subjects.

reviews.review_heading: Good staffs with very bad placements.
reviews.review_text: The labs are nice in the mechanical department, but some department labs and some of the machinery are missing. They can't conduct the lab due to the availability of the machinery. No Wi-Fi for students or staffs. We can use the computer lab to assess the internet. Hostels are too bad. Canteen is available, but dishes won't be nice.

reviews.review_heading: I love the college infrastructure, but I hate the placements that are offered to the students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good to see from out. The drinking water facility is not good. The laboratories are available, and the equipment in it is in good working condition. But some machinery is missing in the lab. The classrooms and canteen are good. There is no Wi-Fi facility for the students. The hostel rooms are too bad. The library is great. The medical facility is not present in our college. For sports, no special care is given.

reviews.review_text: The campus is huge and beautiful classrooms are regularly maintained neatly. We don't have proper lab facility for automobile department. The university must build the proper labs particularly for automobile department. We don't expect the management to build labs.

Mainly the food is not good.

content.Placements: At MITRC 75 percent students secure placements annually. The peak salary package offered is around 12 LPA notably for roles like Data Analyst. Other roles include software development, data science experts, and various engineering positions.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of MITRC is well-equipped with projectors and original audiovisual aids in classrooms. There are model labs with industry-relevant equipment for practical sessions, and the campus 1,000 plus computers with internet access for academic use, including those in the hostel for academic and research purposes. The hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls, with room amenities such as attached washrooms, 24/7 electricity backup, a water purification system, laundry services, and dining facilities. The mess provides four meals per day, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner.

individual_reviews.title: Facts about college life and stream.

content.Placements: About 40-50% of students get placed in the civil engineering course. The highest salary package offered is dependent on the talent of students and the company. The average salary package offered in this course ranges from 3-4 LPA. Civil engineering is the main branch of B.Tech. It has more opportunities for government jobs like IAS, AEN, JEN, XEN, IPS, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides all facilities including study, canteen, sports, hostel, medical, etc.
content.Faculty: Our college has well structure of faculty members from different branches. Generally, most of the faculty members are from other states. They are well-disciplined and educated. This course makes the students ready for industry purposes and for various government agencies. Our semester exams are conducted by Bikaner Technical University about every 6 months. Every student must get a grade of A to E to pass exams in every respective subject. At grade F student is considered to be failed, and students can try again to pass it. The civil engineering course needs to handle the structural basis of the subject. Practical explanations of all the subjects are very important for smart learning skills. We know that civil engineering has more site work in comparison to office work so all practical work is important to perform and learn accurately.

placements.overview:
Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The institute offers courses like M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.Sc. and PG Diploma. These courses are offered in Full Time and Part Time mode. A total of 24 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Humanities & Social Sciences and Science. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology offers a wide range of programmes at PG level. With option for Full Time and Part Time learning, students can choose from several streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies and IT & Software. At the PG stage, courses available include M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM and M.Sc. Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology fee structure ranges between INR 1,00,000 to 4,00,000.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology offers a wide range of programmes at PG level. With option for Full Time and Part Time learning, students can choose from several streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies and IT & Software. At the PG stage, courses available include M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM and M.Sc. Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology fee structure ranges between INR 1,00,000 to 4,00,000.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Electronics (IoT and Robotics) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Life at Digital University, Kerala.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of electronics students with IoT and robotics placements is very low. However, for other courses like data analytics and machine intelligence, the university provides good placement assistance. They get placed with around 6 LPA to 10 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are awesome. The whole university is air-conditioned and has world-class laboratories. We also have free internet and classrooms are good. The campus is open 24X7 for all the students. This year onwards hostel facilities are only available for girls, not for boys. Special North Indian, South Indian, veg, and non-veg food are available in the hostel mess.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Data Analytics (Data Analytics and Computational Science) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: It is a comfortable campus with great infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Different students of our college work in different companies for data analysis and different computer software. Their maximum salary is 9 Lacs and the minimum salary is 6.5 Lacs per annum. The college has an internship after the two-year course, and the stipend is 5500.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is equipped with many good things where one can have a great time. The college is equipped with free high-speed test quality Wi-Fi. Besides, our college has a library, many classes, and various auditorium rooms. Everything in the college is controlled by the college staff.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: My College experience .

review_content.Placements: Placement opportunities are not available from college side. 30-40% senior got placed in my course. The highest package was 8 LPA for last year, average 4 LPA & the lowest 2.5 LPA. 8-9 companies visited only for recruitment. Through college only 10% got internship in our batch in the college project only. Roles offered are Security analyst etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is good, girls hostel is also good. Wi-Fi, lab, classroom, library everything you can avail in night also. Hostel facilities are very good, it's a 2 seater room. Wi-Fi, mess facility & all other facility are available. Mess food is okay, medical facility is also available. You can also issue sports items.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Computer Science (Machine Intelligence) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: The college has a training and placement cell that prepares the students for forthcoming interviews for internships and job placements. The top recruiters for the college are TCS, Wipro, Informatics, SUNTEC, etc. Many companies visited our college, like Ranbaxy, etc. Some of the students from Industrial Chemistry were placed, and some students got jobs in coaching institutes.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is one large hostel for boys and one hostel for girls, both consisting of a common room. They also have 24-hour Wi-Fi connectivity along with access to newspapers, magazines, and TVs. Round-the-clock water and electricity are available. We have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year, but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects: physical, organic, and inorganic Chemistry. I will opt for Physical Chemistry as my elective in the second year.

review_summary.college_name: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Electronics (IoT and Robotics) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Life at Digital University, Kerala.

content.Placements: The percentage of electronics students with IoT and robotics placements is very low. However, for other courses like data analytics and machine intelligence, the university provides good placement assistance. They get placed with around 6 LPA to 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are awesome. The whole university is air-conditioned and has world-class laboratories. We also have free internet and classrooms are good. The campus is open 24X7 for all the students. This year onwards hostel facilities are only available for girls, not for boys. Special North Indian, South Indian, veg, and non-veg food are available in the hostel mess.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Data Analytics (Data Analytics and Computational Science) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a comfortable campus with great infrastructure.

content.Placements: Different students of our college work in different companies for data analysis and different computer software. Their maximum salary is 9 Lacs and the minimum salary is 6.5 Lacs per annum. The college has an internship after the two-year course, and the stipend is 5500.
content.Infrastructure: The college is equipped with many good things where one can have a great time. The college is equipped with free high-speed test quality Wi-Fi. Besides, our college has a library, many classes, and various auditorium rooms. Everything in the college is controlled by the college staff.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My College experience .

content.Placements: Placement opportunities are not available from college side. 30-40% senior got placed in my course. The highest package was 8 LPA for last year, average 4 LPA & the lowest 2.5 LPA. 8-9 companies visited only for recruitment. Through college only 10% got internship in our batch in the college project only. Roles offered are Security analyst etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is good, girls hostel is also good. Wi-Fi, lab, classroom, library everything you can avail in night also. Hostel facilities are very good, it's a 2 seater room. Wi-Fi, mess facility & all other facility are available. Mess food is okay, medical facility is also available. You can also issue sports items.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Computer Science (Machine Intelligence) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: The college has a training and placement cell that prepares the students for forthcoming interviews for internships and job placements. The top recruiters for the college are TCS, Wipro, Informatics, SUNTEC, etc. Many companies visited our college, like Ranbaxy, etc. Some of the students from Industrial Chemistry were placed, and some students got jobs in coaching institutes.
content.Infrastructure: There is one large hostel for boys and one hostel for girls, both consisting of a common room. They also have 24-hour Wi-Fi connectivity along with access to newspapers, magazines, and TVs. Round-the-clock water and electricity are available. We have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year, but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects: physical, organic, and inorganic Chemistry. I will opt for Physical Chemistry as my elective in the second year.
